test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the correct definition of liberalisation ?

options.text: It is the process by which an economy is transformed from an agricultural one to the manufacturing of goods.
It is a policy that focuses on the boosting of government laws and restrictions in order to encourage greater participation by public entities.
It is a situation where there is a single seller in the market.
It is a process of removing controls systems in order to encourage economic development.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is a process of removing control systems in order to encourage economic development.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Liberalisation:**

__
 
• **Liberalisation is the process or means of the elimination of control of the state over economic activities.**
 
• It provides greater autonomy to the business enterprises in decision-making and eliminates government interference.
 
• Liberalisation was begun to put an end to limitations, and open multiple areas of the economy.
 
• For developing countries, liberalisation has opened economic borders to foreign companies and investments.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The process by which an economy is transformed from agriculture to manufacturing of goods is called** industrialisation.**
 
• Industrialisation leads to urbanisation.
 
• **Regulatory policy** focuses on boosting of government laws and restrictions in order to encourage greater participation by public entities.
 
• In a **monopoly market**, the seller faces no competition, as he is the sole seller of goods with no close substitute.
